people.name: Laban
people.line: Brother of Rebekah; father of Leah and Rachel

translations.web: Laban said, “It is better that I give her to you, than that I should give her to another man. Stay with me.”
translations.bsb: Laban replied, “Better that I give her to you than to another. Stay here with me.”
translations.kjv: And Laban said, It is better that I give her to thee, than that I should give her to another man: abide
translations.asv: And Laban said, It is better that I give her to thee, than that I should give her to another man. Abide with me.
